content:
If you love the new wallpapers Apple designed for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use them—you can download them right here now.

Download the new iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers

While the default iOS wallpapers are dynamic and react to your device's movement and gestures, the ones provided below are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 release candidate.

The release candidate does not appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few more weeks, possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap the image to download the full-resolution wallpaper, then set it as your background through the Photos app or the Settings app (if you're on an iOS device).
